payload.body: Merged to main (c4fc05c) via fast-forward. Adversarial review caught a stale config.test.ts assertion (agent removed the 'postgres not yet implemented' guard but left the test asserting it); fixed + added a positive postgres+URL case. Combined server suite: 728 passed/20 skipped. NOTE: pg SQL is not exercised in CI yet (no Postgres service) — live-PG suite skips; FR-26 adds the CI service.
